_why: Contract example on v1.1 numbers. Walk +Z 0.1 m/tick: mote at z=5 in range at z=4 -> tick 40, carried 2+1=3 (pickup scores 0). Shade S1 chases head-on at 4/60 m/tick: before the pulse the gap is 17.05 - k/6 > 1. Pulse (input 80 -> tick 81): shade z = 17.05-80/15 = 11.717, player z = 8.1, 3D distance from feet+0.8 = sqrt(3.617^2+0.2^2) = 3.62 <= 5 -> stunned 81..200, pushed 4 m to 15.717, cost 3 -> carried 0, +5. Player stops at z=12 (tick 120); interact at tick 121 is 13 m from L1 -> nothing. Shade chases again from 201: gap 3.717 - (k-200)/15 <= 1 at k=241 -> hit (flames 2, dropped floor(0/2)=0). Next hit could only be 241+90 = 331 > 300. Score 5.
